scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text:
Hello, guest.
This place is the docks.

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text: We don't have any ships operating right now. But the scenery is nice, feel free to take a look around for a while!

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text: In accordance with the Gardeners' plant cultivation and herbicide plans. Admission to the water garden is limited once per day for both the normal and hard water garden.

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text:
Thank you for your understanding.
Please take enough rest and come back again after dawn!

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text:
Would you like to take a ride to the water garden?
The ship only run once a day!

^FF0000Please note that, any abnormal monster handling inside the instance such as taming, is not considered normal.^000000

^FF0000The party leader who received the quest for the 'Water Garden' or 'Water Garden Hard' must enter the instance to proceed. In the case of party leader changes, the instance will be cancelled and you may not proceed.^000000

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text:
You can tell me if you want to enter the water garden.
But it's dangerous inside. You can't enter right now.
- This MD is for level 180 or above. -

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text:
The instance has not been created yet.
Please check it.

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text:
The instance has not been created yet.
Please check it.

scripts.speaker: Harad
scripts.text: When the {0} MD has opened, please speak to me again and select ^0000CDEnter {1}^000000.
- You can enter the water garden after the party leader has entered the MD. -

scripts.speaker: Hetilla
scripts.text:
Guests, welcome to the water garden,
Are you going to see Papilla? Papilla's been very sensitive about the intruders lately...

scripts.speaker: Hetilla
scripts.text:
Papillas are playing around here and there.
They use psychedelic materials from their wings to make short distance movements or use a dangerous magic over them.

scripts.speaker: Hetilla
scripts.text:
I warned you on advanced, but be careful.
Pruning all overgrown plants and animals opens the door to the next area at 3 o'clock.
